headline: Colombia Central Bank Keeps Benchmark Interest Rate Unchanged at 12.25%
summary: Colombia's central bank decided to leave interest rates unchanged, maintaining its benchmark policy rate at 12.25%. Four directors voted in favor of the decision while three voted for a 25 basis point increase.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions dictate the cost of borrowing throughout the economy, influencing currency valuation, domestic spending, and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Interest rate pauses directly impact Colombian borrowing costs and economic activity.
